lines.en:
What do you make of this situation,
Andrew?

Well, the Kingdom Army is managing
to hold the Imperial troops at bay...
lines.ru:
Ну, армия Королевства пока
сдерживает имперцев...

lines.en:
But they're fairly well outnumbered.
Unless they have reinforcements on
the way, they're going to lose.
lines.ru:
Но их явно меньше. Если
подкрепление не на подходе, они
проиграют.

lines.en:
We ARE the reinforcements, Andrew!
Let's hurry!
